intent: An educated adult reader with no assumed familiarity with the piece's specific domain. Default preset when no audience is stated; see editorial/profiles/README.md for the override rule.
domain_familiarity: No assumed prior exposure to the domain's vocabulary or internal debates.
purpose: Wants to understand what happened or what is being argued, and why it matters, without needing to become a practitioner.
assumed_knowledge: no assumed familiarity with the domain's technical vocabulary or standard practice

text.explanation_depth: define a technical term in plain language the first time it appears
text.section_granularity: short sections, one idea developed per section
text.sentence_complexity: prefer single-clause sentences; unpack multi-step inferences rather than compressing them

visual.label_density: low; only labels that are load-bearing for the point
visual.acronym_expansion: expand every acronym in-frame on first appearance

audio.term_glossing: gloss every technical term on first use
audio.useful_recurrence: state the main takeaway once, clearly, near the end

anti_patterns: Talking down: over-explaining concepts a general adult reader already grasps by analogy to daily life
Assuming domain vocabulary without ever having introduced it
Burying the point under qualification the reader has no context to weigh
